name: AI Smart Travel Planner
description: Personalized itineraries through a multi-agent workflow, with saved trips, authentication, and PDF export.
summary: A complete planning workflow takes travelers from preferences to saved, printable itineraries. Specialized agents organize the planning tasks, while authentication and persistent trip management support returning users.
architecture: A Next.js client sends planning preferences to FastAPI. LangGraph coordinates specialized planning agents using OpenAI, while SQLAlchemy persists user-owned trips in PostgreSQL. ReportLab produces downloadable itineraries. Live travel provider integrations are optional.

capabilities.name: Multi-agent planning
capabilities.description: Combine destination, dates, budget, and interests into a structured itinerary.

capabilities.name: Saved trips
capabilities.description: Authenticate users and save, rename, duplicate, and share their trips.

stack.usage: App Router pages provide the planning form, trip results, and saved-trip workspace.
React components coordinate preference inputs and itinerary display.
TypeScript defines request payloads and trip data for frontend modules.
Utility styles support responsive planning forms and itinerary views.
HTTP routes expose planning, authentication, saved trips, and export operations.
Python implements itinerary services, persistence integration, and document generation.
A graph runs specialized flight, hotel, weather, activity, budget, and itinerary steps.
The OpenAI SDK supplies model responses when AI mode is configured; fallback mode remains available.
ORM models and sessions store users and saved itinerary records.
PostgreSQL persists accounts, trips, and shared-trip data.
ReportLab renders trip information into downloadable PDF files.
Docker Compose coordinates frontend, backend, and database development services.
Backend tests mock AI providers to exercise services without paid API calls.

architectureConnections.description: Planning preferences travel from the frontend to the versioned backend.
The planning endpoint executes the specialized-agent workflow.
Trip models are persisted through database sessions.
